# northflank_deployment_service (Resource)

Manages a Northflank deployment service: a long-running workload that runs an external image or the output of a Northflank build service. For a service that also builds from Git, Northflank has combined services, which this provider does not manage yet.

`runtime_environment` values are stored in Terraform state. Treat the state file as a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_project" "app" {
  name   = "My Application"
  region = "europe-west"
}

# A public HTTP API running an image from a private registry.
resource "northflank_deployment_service" "api" {
  project_id      = northflank_project.app.id
  name            = "API"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-20"
  instances       = 2

  deployment = {
    external_image = {
      image_path     = "ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4"
      credentials_id = "ghcr-credentials"
    }
    command = "node server.js"
  }

  ports = [
    {
      name          = "http"
      internal_port = 8080
      protocol      = "HTTP"
      public        = true
    },
  ]

  health_checks = [
    {
      type                  = "readinessProbe"
      protocol              = "HTTP"
      path                  = "/healthz"
      port                  = 8080
      initial_delay_seconds = 5
      period_seconds        = 10
      timeout_seconds       = 2
      failure_threshold     = 3
    },
  ]

  runtime_environment = {
    LOG_LEVEL = "info"
  }
}

# A private worker running the latest build of a Northflank build service.
resource "northflank_deployment_service" "worker" {
  project_id      = northflank_project.app.id
  name            = "Worker"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-10"

  deployment = {
    build_service = {
      id     = "api-builder"
      branch = "main"
    }
    command = "node worker.js"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (Attributes) What the service runs. Set exactly one of `external_image` or `build_service`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment))
- `deployment_plan` (String) ID of the compute plan each instance uses, such as `nf-compute-20`.
- `name` (String) Name of the service, 3 to 54 characters. Changing this forces a new service, since Northflank derives the `id` from it and cannot rename one.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the service belongs to. Changing this forces a new service.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description of the service, up to 200 characters. Removing it from configuration keeps the current value.
- `health_checks` (Attributes List) Probes Northflank uses to decide whether an instance is started, alive and ready. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_checks))
- `instances` (Number) Number of instances to run. `0` scales the service down without deleting it. Defaults to `1`.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports the service listens on, and whether each is reachable from the internet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `runtime_environment` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables set on every instance, as a map of name to value. Values shared by several services belong in a `northflank_secret_group`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Previously defined Northflank tags to attach to the service.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) Full identifier Northflank uses for the service's deployment.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the service, derived by Northflank from `name`.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the service. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.

<a id="nestedatt--deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment`

Optional:

- `build_service` (Attributes) Run the output of a Northflank build service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment--build_service))
- `command` (String) Command to run instead of the image's `CMD`.
- `entrypoint` (String) Entrypoint to run instead of the image's `ENTRYPOINT`.
- `external_image` (Attributes) Run an image from a container registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment--external_image))

<a id="nestedatt--deployment--build_service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment.build_service`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the build service: `my-builder` in the same project, or `other-project/my-builder` in another one.

Optional:

- `branch` (String) Branch whose builds to deploy.
- `build_sha` (String) Commit to deploy: a full 40-character SHA, or `latest` for the most recent build. Defaults to `latest`.


<a id="nestedatt--deployment--external_image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment.external_image`

Required:

- `image_path` (String) Image to run, such as `nginx:latest` or `ghcr.io/org/image:tag`. Images outside Docker Hub need the registry host.

Optional:

- `credentials_id` (String) ID of saved registry credentials, for a private image.



<a id="nestedatt--health_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_checks`

Required:

- `failure_threshold` (Number) Failed checks in a row before the instance counts as failing, 1 to 255.
- `initial_delay_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait before the first check, 1 to 1800.
- `period_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks, 10 to 600.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP` (needs `path` and `port`), `TCP` (needs `port`) or `CMD` (needs `cmd`).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait for a response, 1 to 60.
- `type` (String) `livenessProbe`, `readinessProbe` or `startupProbe`.

Optional:

- `cmd` (String) Command to run inside the container.
- `path` (String) HTTP path to request, such as `/healthz`.
- `port` (Number) Port to check.
- `success_threshold` (Number) Successful checks in a row before the instance counts as healthy. Defaults to `1`.


<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `internal_port` (Number) Port number the container listens on.
- `name` (String) Name identifying the port, up to 8 characters.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTP/2`, `TCP` or `UDP`. Only HTTP ports can be public.

Optional:

- `domains` (Set of String) Custom domains routed to this port. Each must already be verified in Northflank.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the port is exposed to the internet. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Deployment services are imported as <project_id>/<service_id>.
terraform import northflank_deployment_service.api my-application/api
```
